about_the_game:
You awaken to find yourself in a bizarre village.

An obsessive suitor is pursuing you, desperate to claim a kiss!

You must determine if every hut in the village is completely identical to the first one in order to obtain the key to escape.

Only one chance awaits!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This game was entirely self-taught and independently developed by the creator. If you encounter bugs or have feedback, feel free to contact the developer for troubleshooting or a refund.
Thank you for your support!
